article_title_id: 7 Tanda Bisnis Anda Sudah Butuh SAP Business One
article_title_en: 7 Signs Your Business Has Outgrown Spreadsheets and Needs SAP Business One

images.concept: Indonesian SME business owner or finance manager reviewing operations at a decision point — evoking the 7-signs readiness theme
images.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a professional Indonesian woman in her early 40s, wearing business casual attire, seated at a modern clean-lined office desk, intently reviewing financial dashboards on a laptop and a tablet simultaneously, warm natural light streaming from large windows behind her, shallow depth of field with a softly blurred open-plan corporate office background showing glass partitions and colleagues in the distance, expression focused and thoughtful as if weighing an important business decision, corporate B2B aesthetic, cool blue and warm amber accent tones, professional trade-publication quality, 16:9 aspect ratio, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no readable lettering
images.alt_id: Pemilik bisnis UKM perempuan Indonesia meninjau dasbor keuangan di laptop dan tablet di kantor modern
images.alt_en: Indonesian SME business owner reviewing financial dashboards on a laptop and tablet in a modern office
images.caption_id: Saat data keuangan harus dikumpulkan dari banyak sumber sebelum bisa dianalisis, itu pertanda sistem operasional bisnis sudah mulai menahan pertumbuhan. Mengenali tanda-tanda lebih awal memberi ruang untuk memilih solusi dengan kepala dingin.
images.caption_en: When financial data must be gathered from multiple sources before it can be analyzed, the operating system is slowing the business down rather than supporting it. Recognizing the signs early leaves room to make the right call without pressure.

images.concept: Visual metaphor contrasting fragmented spreadsheets and disconnected tools on one side vs. a single unified ERP dashboard on the other
images.prompt: Clean conceptual split-screen flat illustration in a modern B2B SaaS style, left half depicting visual chaos: a cluttered desk with scattered paper ledgers, sticky notes in different colors, and three mismatched monitor screens each showing different disconnected spreadsheet grids, muted red and grey tones, slight visual tension, right half depicting calm order: a single large monitor displaying a clean unified dashboard with smooth connected workflow icons representing finance, sales, inventory, and purchasing all flowing into one central hub, cool blue and green tones, visual sense of clarity and integration, a subtle vertical dividing line between the two halves, minimalist office setting, professional enterprise software aesthetic, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no readable lettering
images.alt_id: Ilustrasi kontras antara sistem terfragmentasi dengan spreadsheet terpisah di kiri dan dasbor ERP terintegrasi di kanan
images.alt_en: Illustration contrasting fragmented disconnected spreadsheets on the left with a single integrated ERP dashboard on the right
images.caption_id: Software akuntansi bekerja dalam silo — hanya mencatat data keuangan historis per departemen. ERP seperti SAP Business One menghubungkan keuangan, penjualan, pembelian, dan inventaris dalam satu database terpusat sehingga satu transaksi langsung memperbarui semua modul terkait.
images.caption_en: Accounting software works in silos, recording historical financial data per department. An ERP like SAP Business One connects finance, sales, purchasing, and inventory in one central database so a single transaction updates every related module automatically.
images.fallback_note: Split-composition illustrations are manageable for FLUX dev; if the two-halves visual reads as cluttered rather than purposefully contrasted, consider a stock illustration of 'ERP integration concept' from Adobe Stock.

images.concept: Clean modern timeline or project roadmap conveying the 5 phased implementation steps to go-live, without depending on legible text
images.prompt: Modern flat illustration of a professional project roadmap scene, a diverse team of three business consultants standing around a large bright glass whiteboard in a contemporary corporate meeting room, the whiteboard displays a horizontal left-to-right connected milestone path with five distinct circular milestone nodes connected by arrows, each node contains only a simple abstract icon (no text), the nodes progress in color from cool grey on the far left through increasingly saturated teal and then to a vivid green node on the far right representing completion, floor-to-ceiling windows in the background with a city skyline, clean white and light grey interior, warm natural daylight, professional B2B enterprise aesthetic, sense of forward momentum and collaborative planning, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no readable lettering
images.alt_id: Tim konsultan mendiskusikan peta jalan implementasi lima fase di papan kaca modern dengan jalur pencapaian berwarna progresif
images.alt_en: Consultant team discussing a five-phase implementation roadmap on a modern glass board with a progressive color milestone path
images.caption_id: Metodologi Accelerated Implementation Program (AIP) membagi proyek SAP Business One menjadi lima fase — dari persiapan proyek hingga go-live dan hypercare. Untuk UKM dengan proses yang terdokumentasi rapi, total durasi tipikal berada di rentang 3–6 bulan.
images.caption_en: SAP's Accelerated Implementation Program (AIP) splits a Business One project into five phases — from project preparation through go-live and hypercare. For an SME with well-documented processes, the typical total runs 3–6 months.
